business_summary: Tanabe Consulting Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the management consulting activities in Japan. The company provides strategy consultants for business management, business model transformation, food, manufacturing, construction, global business, government, and public services; digital consultant includes DX vision, digital marketing, management DX, and strategy and operations; HR consultant for strategic HR, human capital management, recruitment and career design, corporate university, top management programs, HR tech, and talent assessment; and marketing and sales consultant includes new business ventures run by female teams, customer creation for existing businesses, on-site sales support, DE&I support, sales design, and customer success. It also provides corporate well-being consultants for clinical psychologists, mental health and welfare workers, public health nurses, industrial counselors, CEAP, and career consultant; corporate finance consultant includes holdings and group management, business succession, ipo support, alliances, and management systems; merger and acquisition consultant for growth strategy, business succession, financial advisory, and cross-border; brand and PR consultant includes branding, public relations, strategic PR and overseas PR, SNS management, and content marketing management support; and CRM consultant for client relations, MA tools, database marketing, and telemarketing. The company was formerly known as Tanabe Consulting Co.,Ltd. The company was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
